item.title: Commission assesses gallium supply risk for European defence electronics
item.description: The European Commission is assessing the gallium supply risk for European defence electronics after China tightened export licensing for gallium.
item.content:encoded:
The European Commission is assessing the gallium supply risk for European defence electronics after China tightened export licensing for gallium.

Gallium nitride is used in radar and electronic warfare power amplifiers. The Commission will consult industry on stockpiles and supply chain options as a critical raw material.

item.title: European Defence Fund backs hypersonic interceptor study
item.description: The European Defence Fund will finance a study on interceptors able to defeat hypersonic glide vehicles, with MBDA among the participants.
item.content:encoded:
The European Defence Fund will finance a study on interceptors able to defeat hypersonic glide vehicles, with MBDA among the participants.

The study covers guidance, propulsion and seekers for an endo-atmospheric interceptor.

item.title: Commission opens EDIP call to expand ammunition production capacity
item.description: The European Commission opened a call for proposals under EDIP to expand ammunition and missile production capacity in Europe.
item.content:encoded:
The European Commission opened a call for proposals under EDIP to expand ammunition and missile production capacity in Europe.

Projects can cover new production lines and the supply chain for energetic materials.
